blocks.text:
Breakfast and departure from the lodge at 07:30. A final walk along the boardwalk to the river, followed by a two-hour motorised canoe trip to Coca for the 35-minute flight back to Quito.

Arrival in Quito at 12:30 (arrival time may change).

Please note: there are no arrivals or departures at the lodge on Sundays.

Transfer to the hotel. Free evening.

Accommodation at Patio Andaluz 4★ www.hotelpatioandaluz.com

(Breakfast)
